subject_rule: Limited by exclusions for the general schemes, not by a list: no scholarships for medical and para-medical courses, law, fashion or integrated courses, and IIT B.Tech is not offered; certificates and diplomas only in Indian languages and literature, performing or visual arts and yoga. Two schemes are narrower: Quad STEM is 4-year bachelor engineering at 8 named institutions, and Lata Mangeshkar is Indian culture fields (plus a yoga diploma).
